_doc: Biome 'Violet Hour' - palette family + fog for act III (DESIGN.md section 10). Geometry is unaffected (view-layer only, D-048). Roles not listed here (slab side, trim, props, dais, gifts, beacon, ambient, fill light, tripmine particles) inherit from data/palette.json (the Deepwater section 12.2 reference), including the 0.35 emission factor for platform/walkway light. Danger stays red/pink and gold stays gold in every biome (DESIGN.md section 10 rules); the tripmine tells (#FF4FD8 particles, six-pointed star) and the straggler/rim colour (#7CFFF4) never change. Note: DESIGN.md section 10 fixes this biome's walkway light at #FF3C7A (hot pink-red); the mines keep #FF4FD8 particles AND the star, and the fog-readability check (TERRAIN_SPEC section 12.3) includes tripmine particles vs platform light >= 3.0 contrast.
